title: Bitcoin Price Struggled in 2025, but Long-Term Lows Show a Strong and Rising Floor
summary: Bitcoin MagazineBitcoin Price Struggled in 2025, but Long-Term Lows Show a Strong and Rising FloorThe bitcoin price's 2025 price swung above $125,000 before falling to around $87,000, reflecting a shift from speculative rallies to macro-driven market forces.This postBitcoin Price Struggled in 2025, but Long-Term Lows Show a Strong and Rising Floorfirst appeared onBitcoin Magazineand is written byMicah Zimmerman.
